en: The image shows a modernist multi-tiered fountain set in a lush, green park. There are two children sitting on the edge of the fountain, and the foreground is filled with flowerbeds displaying red and purple blossoms. The scene is surrounded by tall leafy trees under a bright blue sky. The image has a vintage quality typical of postcards from the latter half of the 20th century.
